s1.syndrome_frame: a postmenopausal woman with a long-standing, progressively enlarging breast mass associated with skin ulceration
salient_findings: mass is hard, non-tender, and mobile
skin breakdown with mild exudation and bleeding
key_facts: 56-year-old postmenopausal woman
right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
mass has gradually enlarged
mass is hard in texture
mass is non-tender
mass is mobile
skin ulceration over the mass
mild exudation and bleeding from the ulceration
breast ultrasound classified the lesion as BI-RADS category V
MRI classified the lesion as BI-RADS category V
chest CT demonstrated a right breast mass suggestive of malignancy
serum breast tumor markers were within normal limits
no palpable axillary or supraclavicular lymphadenopathy

raw.syndrome_frame: a postmenopausal woman with a long-standing, progressively enlarging breast mass associated with skin ulceration
salient_findings: mass is hard, non-tender, and mobile
skin breakdown with mild exudation and bleeding
key_facts: 56-year-old postmenopausal woman
right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
mass has gradually enlarged
mass is hard in texture
mass is non-tender
mass is mobile
skin ulceration over the mass
mild exudation and bleeding from the ulceration

no palpable axillary or supraclavicular lymphadenopathy

differentials: Squamous cell carcinoma of the breast
per_call: Squamous cell carcinoma of the breast

shortlist.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: most common type of breast cancer, consistent with hard texture and skin ulceration

shortlist.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: skin ulceration and rapid progression are characteristic features

shortlist.label: Paget's disease of the breast
shortlist.why_kept: skin ulceration and nipple-areolar complex involvement are typical

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: rapid growth and large size are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Metaplastic breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: aggressive behavior and skin ulceration are possible features

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with a hard, non-tender, and mobile breast mass, along with skin ulceration and a BI-RADS category V classification on both ultrasound and MRI, is most consistent with invasive ductal carcinoma, which is the most common type of breast cancer and can cause skin ulceration and bleeding.

rejected.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
rejected.why: Inflammatory breast cancer typically presents with rapid onset of erythema, edema, and warmth of the breast, which is not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Paget's disease of the breast
rejected.why: Paget's disease of the breast typically presents with eczematous changes of the nipple-areolar complex, which is not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors are typically large, rapidly growing masses, but they are less likely to cause skin ulceration and are often benign.

rejected.label: Metaplastic breast cancer
rejected.why: Metaplastic breast cancer is a rare subtype of breast cancer, and the patient's presentation does not specifically suggest this diagnosis over invasive ductal carcinoma.
